explanation: Count each age, assign its destination block, then swap people into the next vacant slot of their age’s block. Remove a block’s offset when all its entries have been placed.
timeComplexity: O(nu) conservative bound including repeated HashMap iterator initialization, for u distinct ages; O(n) swaps
